name: Kittengumi Short: Chapter 0
source:
A short visual novel set in the peculiar universe of Kittengumi. Meet its characters, make decisions, and discover what lies behind this title.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305440/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部以《Kittengumi》的奇妙世界为背景的短篇视觉小说。结识其中的角色，作出决定，揭开这个名字背后的故事。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305440/]Steam[/url]］
